name: harness
description: Skills, agents, hooks and scripts for PR review, commit breakdowns, PR summaries and worktree flow

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Interpreter for harness hooks only; skill commands do not receive it, so pin those with HARNESS_PY. Needs jsonschema, referencing and pydantic>=2.

bash_discipline.title: Block compound Bash commands
bash_discipline.description: Deny Bash commands chained with && or ; (one command per call).

inject_rules.title: Inject harness rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Add rules/HARNESS_RULES.md to the session context on SessionStart.
